_comment: Site-wide pop-up. mode 'acknowledge' shows it each visit until the visitor clicks 'Don't show this again'; closing with X or Esc only dismisses for that session. Change 'id' for a NEW message so people who acknowledged the last one see the new one. Other modes: 'once' (a single time ever), 'untilDate' (with endDate), 'always'. A message can also run for a set time: "until" (YYYY-MM-DD) ends it and "then" holds the announcement that takes over. mode 'every' shows it on every visit until 'Don't show this again' (X, Esc and 'Maybe later' remember nothing). layout 'hiring' is the job-posting card (see js/redesign-announce.js).
